proves.claim: With read.thinCommands on, show of a plain item prints the same lines and exit code as with it off.

cli.commands-show.thin-equal.why: The thin door may only change how the facts are read, never what show prints.

proves.claim: With read.thinCommands on, show of an item with a thread entry prints the full path lines, the thin door returning null.

cli.commands-show.thin-null-falls-back.why: An item with a receipt or thread entry needs the heavy sections the thin door does not read.
